notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using two colored mana.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken artifact creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
If necessary, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior token, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
